claims.statement: Tom Allen's place was at 619 Market street.
claims.excerpt: ToM ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of the world, 619 Market street.

claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised a free concert every evening at his place, with only the best singers engaged.
claims.excerpt: Free concert every evening. Best of singers only engaged here.

claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised himself as the retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: ToM ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of the world

notes: Repeated advertisement; it is an ad, so it is the only source for the free concert. Allen is named only in his own notice.
